page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This memory-optimized configuration is designed for workloads requiring significant RAM capacity relative to compute resources. The server does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density provide a predictable resource profile for enterprise workloads, though the lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff for storage-heavy or parallel-processing tasks. This hardware profile is appropriate for memory-intensive applications, in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
